column1: # (Written by Claude for Max 2026-11-13; revised after notes/review_lead_2026-11-13.md) R2's error budget before and after sprint 10 (R2 seed 1, 282 targets; fractions of each target's variance; normalized error 0.665; primary setting, in which the model is given the biosample's ChIP-seq control). value = the point used in the figure; low, high = the range where estimators, matchings or subsets disagree. The parts come from different subsets: the noise floor from sprint 07 (ENCODE replicates for 180 targets, pseudoreplicate transfer for 54, assay medians for 48); the replicate level parts from 377 per-replicate tracks; the experiment-specific and reproduced level parts from 176 targets with a second experiment (value = midpoint of two estimators); the systematic non-level part from 103 targets with a second experiment from another lab (range: same-lab ladder 0.024 to the other estimator's 0.066); not reproduced and reachable from sprint 09 (176 targets). Sources: sprint 09 section 3 (row "before"); notes/ladder.md, output/ladder/split.tsv, fu_results.tsv, triangulate.tsv; notes/syscac.md, output/syscac/review_checks.tsv; sprint 09 output/residual.
